title: Cispadane Republic
capsule: Attested in our geometric sources A prior capsule was withdrawn in source review; an accurate one is pending.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The republic's territory is well documented through Napoleonic administrative records and the 1797 merger agreement; its boundaries correspond to the historical Este duchies and papal legations of Bologna and Ferrara.
